name: CheckEligibilityResult
description: Result for the CheckEligibilityByDetails and CheckEligibilityForProduct functions

eligibilityQuery.description: a copy of the input query that was checked against the eligible collateral specification

isEligible.description: a simple boolean which is set to true if the asset described in the EligibilityQuery input is eligible

matchingEligibleCriteria.description: if there was a match, this will be the one or more criteria that were supplied in the EligbilityCollateralSpecification which matched with the query input

specification.description: a copy of the input EligbilityCollateralSpecification that was checked against the query
